title: Treatise on the Forked Lash
summary: Carries the first spark into a whip of charge that wraps, stings and holds a target at arm's length.

title: Canon of the Charged Step
summary: Joins the crack step to longer strides that let the student cross a gap in a flicker and strike on landing.

title: Handbook of the Volt Guard
summary: Builds the thin hum of a first guard into a hardened shell of charge that returns a shock to those who strike it.

title: Drill-Book of the Rolling Peal
summary: Teaches a long roll of thunder-sound and pressure from the hands, from the low rumble to a crash that rattles those near.

title: Treatise on the Nerve Jolt
summary: Sets out how a measured pulse of charge numbs, twitches or frees the nerves, on a foe or on a hurt ally.

title: Workbook of the Held Current
summary: Trains the student to bank charge in the body for long periods and loose it in a charged fist or a held burst.

title: Canon of the Ground Current
summary: Runs charge through the earth beneath the feet, to feel, to strike along the ground and to sink an anchor of defense.

title: Treatise on the Lightning Chain
summary: Links spark to spark in a chain that leaps from one target to the next and breaks the links of a foe's guard.
